notes.content:

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where objects couldn't be picked up after their carrier have been killed;
[*]Fixed a bug where buttons would become unresponsive after finishing the tutorial and going back to the Main Menu;
[*]Fixed a bug that displayed pink artifacts when starting a new run after completing a previous one;
[*]Fixed a bug that would leave particles behind when swapping a relic for a catalyst;
[*]Added missing strings in credits.
[/list]

[h2][b]Bugs we are actively working on[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Working on a bug that sometime causes targeting to stop working on Eleanor;
[*]Working on a bug where followers would sometimes attack neutral ennemies unprovoked upon getting up;
[*] We are looking to fix an issue causing some UI elements to not appear when pressing ESC/Start during loading;
[*] We are looking at improving loading times in general;
[*] We are looking at a couple of more minor annoying bugs in the singleplayer experience.
[*] We are looking into a potential memory leak when leaving the game open for several hours.
[/list]


[h2][b]To be added to Worship's roadmap[/b][/h2]
[p]This new section will now list features and improvements that we are adding to our roadmap planning following player feedback and/or issues that the team judged worth tackling. Keep on telling us how you feel about the game and we'll do our best to focus on what the community is asking for! [/p]
[list]
[*](Community feedback) We heard the feedback regarding the save system and permadeath. We are looking at both short term and long terms improvements to address your issues in that regard.
[*](Community feedback) We are looking at improvements for the symbol recognition, but these might have to wait for the bigger updates planned in the roadmap.
[*](Community feedback) We will look at how we can add more gameplay differences and impact tied to the choice of god to Worship
[*](Community feedback) More resolutions and aspect ratio support
[/list]

[h3][b]Thank you for your patience fellow cultists![/b][/h3]
If you are wondering what we have planned for upcoming content, you can refer to our roadmap on Worship's store page!

- The Chasing Rats Team

notes.title: Early Access Hotfix #08
Shepherd of Horrors - Early Access update
notes.content: [h1]Cultists, Rejoice![/h1][p]The first Worship update has been summoned and is [b]OUT NOW![/b] [/p][p]As promised on the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1548180/view/518593488304996445?l=english"]Early Access roadmap[/url], also visible on the Store page, Shepherd of Horror is our first minor update to make its way into the game. We've been hard at work at not only fixing bugs, but also bringing exciting new content to the world of Worship. [/p][p]Asides from new upgrades/rituals and new things to encounter during your games, the update completely changes Hubryus' starting building, the Mutation Hatchery! This update also adds plenty of improvements to the summons and allies aspect of the game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/91ef9840dc1140bf11be9ed5bd5943f495b0e3b0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]New Content[/b][/h1][h2]Gods-related Cult Abilities Rework[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/dfcd77cd50e85a8833e4b6868a34ba33535b310e.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Hubryus' Mutation Hatchery rework:[/p][list][*][p]You can now sacrifice your followers and fuse them in death to summon Folhorrors allies to fight battles for you. [/p][/*][*][p]Sacrified followers bodies no longer stay behind. Their flesh and blood is used in the making of your subservient abominations. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]An-Ansgaidh's "Berserk Followers" starting upgrade is replaced with the newly introduced "Mercy Killing" upgrade. Mercy Killing gives you some blood back as you offer corpses to your god using the Tribute ritual.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]New Upgrades & Rituals to acquire[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/c8a00a2b7e55475b8f831ba8bc20bff037eaa038.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]New Ritual - Shadow leap[/h3][p]With this new ritual, you can leap to a nearby destination in immaterial shadow form while damaging every foes in your path. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/3cb0cb28fbf3bf17f1bb1ae70add7cd608265fe7.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]New Ritual - Summon Rift Hydra[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/d11914eeadf7602d2e2ddc882e053ae32a6644d3.gif"][/img][/p][p]Invoke a mighty Rift Hydra, the apex predator from the Molewurm species. Legend says if you cut one head in the mortal realm, two regrow in the Unseen Depths and vice-versa. Unfortunately you don’t have a follower with shears at the ready in the other world.[/p][p][/p][h3]Ritual Passive - Noxious shapes[/h3][p]Fumes from the Unseen Depths now seeps into ritual shapes you cast, poisoning the nonbelievers that breathe this cursed air. Your god shall spare the faithful from the noxious effects, but you’ll have to endure the stench.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/7222cf8a4541a3a7488a9a0cb123756c39745f13.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Cultist Passive - Explosive Drinking[/h3][p]Syphoning blood now channels a growing explosion that detonates once you stop absorbing. The more blood absorbed, the deadliest the explosion gets. The perfect marriage of gluttony and wrath.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/8f378e0533c11db9e1624fe3a9a7adfe8e028244.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]An-Ansgaidh's Starting Upgrade - Mercy killing [/h3][p]Apostles of An-Ansgaidh are rewarded for their acts of mercy, notably freeing mortals from their painful existence. Offering corpses as tribute give cultists some blood back.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Encounters to spice up your exploration[/h2][list][*][p][b]A mysterious Kessessa themed puzzle encounter.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Eldritch Hatcheries to turn catalyst into a specific types, which can help cultists achieve their dream synergies.[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Akka blockades, standing their ground against the Last Church and holding precious godless prisoners.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]We don't want to spoil all the fun for these so you'll have to scour the world while seeking devotion for you god to see what secret they hold![/p][p][/p][h2]New Enemy Variant[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/0d6c1c19212c073c159b0055a9b0008f2fab1b37.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Inquisitor Variant - The Heretic Slayer[/h3][list][*][p]This elite variant of the inquisitor can pose a real threat to your cult, starting at the 2nd zone.[/p][/*][*][p]Be wary of his holy shockwave projectiles as well as his lunge combo attack that you should shieldbreak and cancel when you have the chance.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]Changes & Optimization[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Summons and other cultist allies have been improved in the following ways:[/p][list][*][p]Summons and allies now follow you as you head into a Test of Faith and when you are sent back to cult base. [/p][/*][*][p]You can now recall summons and allies to command them to disengage from combat for some time.[/p][/*][*][p]The amount of each summon you can command is now displayed in the ritual description section of grimoire when looking at summoning rituals.[/p][/*][*][p]If you try to summon more allies than your current limit, older summons above the cap are killed and new ones are summoned to take their place.[/p][/*][*][p]Killed summons no longer leave a corpse behind, and instead are burned away and returned to the Unseen Depths.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Interacting with an upgrade buildings will now open the ritual menu to display said upgrade's description[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted catalysts types' random rates to favor ritual catalysts a little bit more[/p][/*][*][p]A memory optimization that makes Worship considerably less memory hungry.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1][p]We tackled a ton of issues in the past few weeks, as you might've noticed with the 7 hotfix patches we released since Worship's release into Early Access. That said, this update also contains its own considerable pile of fixed bugs! In rapid fire:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a navigation issue that made followers unable to path around some collisions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed projectiles playing an impact feedback when colliding with allies.[/p][/*][*][p]Prevented most instances of cultist being able to get to a unintended height.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some visuals on tribute's VFX.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some background scaling in the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an invisible collision in the Untamed Borderlands.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed objects sometimes being impossible to lift or interact with, even with enough followers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed controller issues that made the D-Pad Up close the grimoire menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with liftables' pathing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with followers audio and HUD counter when killed instantly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some errors in some displayed texts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed throw not working in certain contexts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed summons/allies sometimes stacking on the same point.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI not showing up if menu input was pressed during loading.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a small visual asset on the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Followers and allies are now able to properly path around upgrade monuments/buildings[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an interaction with the cultist that sometimes soft-locked the player.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Bugs we are actively working on[/b][/h2][list][*][p]We are looking at fixing objects being sometimes impossible to lift or interact with. We fixed this partially, as stated in the bug fix portion of the patch notes, but there are still some instances where this keeps on happening.[/p][/*][*][p]We are looking at improving loading times in general.[/p][/*][*][p]We are aware of an issue causing performance problems when swarming on destructible objects with a lot of followers.[/p][/*][*][p]We are looking at a couple of more minor annoying bugs in the single player experience. [/p][/*][/list][h2][b]To be added to Worship's roadmap[/b][/h2][p]This new section will now list features and improvements that we are adding to our roadmap planning following player feedback and/or issues that the team judged worth tackling. We are actively reading your feedback, some of which we addressed in this update, some other we have planned in upcoming updates. The next big thing we have planned on the roadmap is a major update planned for Fall 2025:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/2cdb1a394f6f27202f3ff21dc6f6c8aec36bb191.png"][/img][/p][p]Aside from the updates planned on the roadmap, we will continue fixing bugs and releasing hotfix patches to make the game increasingly more stable and eventually bug free.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, what are you waiting for? Don your robes, summon forth forces from the Unseen Depths and plunge the mortal world into madness.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Thank you all so much for delving into the world of Worship![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/99d6f538569a4d439f6881f049fa64971545c816.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]See you next time for a new update![/p][p] - The Chasing Rats team[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/b5dd353493d3b5e05eda80c06aec7ce97a61bde8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/4e336eca7a18e1c3d651bc64b255363f87cc9b8e.png"][/img] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/0b107078298f1796e6130924a22b3f3031e44b90.png"][/img] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/800cae53c2c6c1b8cf6e6fc81f00fea92d4208d4.png"][/img] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/2d2fc1e54687ac88daec184991147802f8bb75c4.png"][/img] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/6fd6a4739e4388018394b57c387f6456cde84742.png"][/img] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/89a90a437dd62dd942d5f523138b87ceb3ad8eb7.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update - Multiplayer, Save System and short term plan
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/ce134a7eeb465e6925187028912d87ac959e4e96.png"][/img]Hello fellow cultists![/p][p][/p][p]A few days has passed since the early access launch and we already received an impressive amount of feedback from players. A lot of players were pretty vocal about their appreciation of the player fantasy, the originality of the game and its various mechanics. Although we’re truly grateful for the positive feedback the community has given us so far, we are also aware that there are parts of the game that need more support and that are not reaching both players’ and our own expectations.[/p][p] [/p][p]An important thing to consider while we are talking about the main issues surrounding the early access launch is that Chasing Rats Games is a small team. We have to prioritize our work towards the most important issues but we can’t tackle them all at the same time and some issues are more time consuming to address than others. Considering this, we want to be as transparent as possible with our players, since we consider this key to a successful Early Access development.  So it’s time to dive into those specific subjects and share our thoughts and plan of actions with the community.[/p][p][/p][h2]Save system[/h2][p]A lot of players have been vocal of their dissatisfaction regarding the save system in Worship. We’ve read every comment on Steam and Discord and we’ve noticed a misunderstanding regarding how the game saves.[/p][p][/p][p]The most common complaint we’ve received is the absence of a save system. To clarify things, there is a save system in Worship, auto-saving your progression at the beginning of every gameplay phase. Every time you reach the Test of Faith (boss fight) or get to a new zone to explore, your progress is saved. This means if you need to take a break during a play session of Worship, you can quit and get back to where you left off when you want. The source of the misunderstanding is probably due to the fact that you lose the progress you’ve made in a run when you die, as it’s commonly the case in roguelites. [/p][p][/p][p]Despite the presence or absence of the Save System, it is clear to us that the way saves and permadeath are handled in Worship in its current form is not meeting players expectations. For these reasons, we’ll take a step back to develop something closer to what players are asking us. We’ll make sure to update you on the subject as soon as we have a better idea of what we can implement and add to the updates planned on the roadmap. [/p][p][/p][h2]State of Multiplayer[/h2][p]We’ve been working day and night to make the online multiplayer functional for the early access release but, as a lot of players stated in the past 24 hours, the state of Worship’s multiplayer is unplayable. It is not up to the players, the Kickstarter backers and our own standards. For these reasons, we made the difficult decision to remove the multiplayer from the main game until we take the time to refactor our code base properly. As stated above, we cannot put our development effort everywhere at once, so in order to simultaneously bring new content updates planned on the roadmap as well as other improvements that you are asking for, we have to put some other things aside. We apologize for the inconvenience of this decision. The Multiplayer Support has been added to the backlog of the roadmap. The Steam page has also been updated for the time being to make sure we are not misleading players looking to join the cult.  [/p][p][/p][p]For those of you who still want to play multiplayer, even in its broken state, a Steam beta branch is available to everybody. The branch is called “beta-multiplayer” and should automatically be included in the Properties section of your game on Steam. [/p][p][/p][p]To access the Steam beta branches, follow these steps:
[/p][olist][*][p]Go to your Steam Library[/p][/*][*][p]Right click on Worship and then click “Properties”[/p][/*][*][p]In the Properties window, find the tab called “Betas”[/p][/*][*][p]In this section, you will find a rolldown menu which includes the “beta-multiplayer” branch. [/p][/*][*][p]By selecting the beta branch, your game will automatically update in your Steam library with the multiplayer available for you to play[/p][/*][*][p]To go back to the main version of Worship, select the “None” option in the rolldown menu[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]We’ll try to update the beta branch as often as we update the game, but keep in mind that some updates might be skipped for this version of the game and we will not be trying to fix the multiplayer issues in the branch until we’ve finished the refactors in the work for the main version of the game. 
[/p][p]We are aware of the frustration some of the players will have towards this decision, we hear you and we feel you. We’re the first to be disappointed when it comes to this, but it is important for us to create a good experience for our players and the multiplayer is just simply not there at the moment. It would not be respectful for players not to act on it and this was the only solution we could make in the short term. We’ll make sure to update the community when we have news regarding multiplayer, but consider this might take months to get there. [/p][p][/p][h2]Everything else[/h2][p]We know these aren’t the only issues Worship has at the moment. Some players voiced inconsistencies with the symbol recognition and several annoying bugs still remain. Please bear with us as we continue pushing hotfix patches while moving towards the updates planned on the roadmap. We are still on track for those, so we hope you are looking forward to the upcoming content and features![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your understanding and your enthusiasm towards Worship. Your feedback is valuable and our main and only priority is to make sure Worship develops into a positive experience for as many people as possible. [/p][p][/p][p]Expect news from us shortly and until then, godspeed everybody,  [/p][list][*][p]Alexis and the Chasing Rats team[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Worship is out in Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/5c23159eaa0b511598f9b340b3ac0966445f700f.png[/img]

Rejoice dear cultists, for Worship is out NOW on Steam. 


Strap along because there are many things regarding backer fulfilment in this update! Let’s go straight into it!

You can watch our very latest trailer to celebrate this Early Access Launch here:

[previewyoutube=g8BDl8pRAzU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]A Few Disclaimers[/h2]
We said this a few times in previous communications, but Early Access is NOT the end of development for Worship. You can read our statement regarding this more extensively here.

Aside from bug fixing, there is still content we wish to push for the game before releasing the full 1.0 version. As such, we plan to update the game over time while it’s still in Early Access.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/ed2b123dc8c1b45f16504b2c86913c711907fe78.png[/img]

The way we’ve structured the Roadmap includes three types of update: 

[b]Minor Updates[/b]: includes new encounters, new upgrades, new rituals and new variants to existing content.
[b]Major Updates[/b]: Includes either a new system in Worship or a significant amount of content, like a new playable zone or game mode. 
[b]Hotfixes[/b]: Includes bug fixing, balancing and small quality of life improvements. Hotfix patches are not scheduled beforehand. 
Our intention is to go back and forth between Minor and Major updates, which all of them will include various amounts of content. We will post a new chapter of the Roadmap after each Major update to give you an idea of what and when to expect in Worship, while giving us flexibility on what we want to prioritize for the long term development of Worship. 

Keep in mind that our release targets for the roadmap can be influenced by the amount of hotfixes and bug fixing on our plate. Releasing in Early Access adds a new layer on development for which we assume we’ll have to do some adaptation in our workflow at the start. 

[h3]Multiplayer[/h3]
As stated in our previous post, the network has, by far, been the most difficult part of development and the main reason for delays in development. Considering this, we are releasing with functional, yet highly unstable, multiplayer support. It is in a somewhat acceptable state for early access and our goal is to get to a way better perfect state for 1.0 with the support from the community. 

Currently, joining a multiplayer lobby is via codes only. If you want to “open” your lobby to strangers, we’ll create a Discord channel in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/chasingratsgames]server [/url]to facilitate the exchange of codes. Look out for #lobby-codes on Discord!

Bugs and other features requiring a bit more polish
As stated above, we chose to be launching in Early Access to collect as much feedback as possible from as many players as possible as we continue to develop the game. While we worked extra hard on polishing the game and fixing bugs, the game is not quite free of them just yet.

We ask that if you have feedback to share or bugs to report, to share them to us directly using the links below.

For feedback: https://worship.fillout.com/t/u76vmzQsvLus 
For bugs: https://bugs.chasingratsgames.com/ 

For the remainder of 2025, we’re also hosting a special contest regarding bug hunting. More details below!

[h2]Chasing Bugs Competition [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/ce134a7eeb465e6925187028912d87ac959e4e96.png[/img]
[h3]CALLING EVERY WORSHIP PLAYER! We need YOU to come break our game[/h3]

We’ll be hosting a contest where you’ll be submitting your craziest, funniest and wildest bugs you can find while playing our game. The prize? A good laugh and you might win some exclusive merch in exchange if the community like your submission. You read that right!

[h3]Rules[/h3]
Everyday for the first week, then every week until the end of July, and then once a month until December, a new thread will open up in a specially designed Chasing Bugs thread. After the time period is over,  a winner will be picked from your submissions via votes from the community and the thread will close. The official rules and schedule for the contest will be included in the Discord Thread. Look up for #chasing-bugs in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/chasingratsgames]Server[/url]!

The bugs reported have to be from Worship’s current Steam version (obviously ;) ).

We hope  the community will have a good time despite the shaky state of multiplayer while we are hard at work making it more stable. The goal for this contest is to submit funny bugs clips, not bug reports! If you just want to report bugs to us, use the regular forms here: https://bugs.chasingratsgames.com/

The contest is open to everyone, not just backers! 
 

[h3]To Participate[/h3]
Submit your bugs in the unlocked daily/weekly/monthly thread in #chasing-bugs  with a picture/Gif/video!
To be eligible for participation, you have to send visuals. We need the funny for people to react. And proof the bug happened!
 

[h3]VOTE! 🫵[/h3]
We need the community (that’s you!) to vote for the funniest bugs! A special reaction will be created to pick the winner, but feel free to react away with your most unhinged Discord emotes! Voting is open to everyone, even if you haven’t submitted a bug!

[h3]The Prize[/h3]
If you win, you’ll be granted a special role in our Discord [url=https://discord.com/invite/chasingratsgames]Server [/url]to highlight your talents as amazing bug hunters as well as one of the following options:

- An additional copy of Worship;
- A very exclusive, limited edition Worship merch™.
Said limited-edition merch will be revealed on Discord later today!

You can win one of each rewards, but after that, we’ll be distributing the rewards to second place, third place, etc if they also have won all the possible rewards.

We still encourage people to submit their bugs at https://bugs.chasingratsgames.com/, but participation in this contest is totally optional. Your participation will not be counted if you only submit your bugs through the link above.

For bugs you find that you can’t reproduce or can’t snap pictures or videos of because they’re rare, we recommend that you submit them through https://bugs.chasingratsgames.com/, as any submission there goes straight into our workflow. Anything helps us in the grand scheme of bug fixing!


[h2]Closing Words[/h2]
Thats it for now! We just took a major step regarding the project and we’re super excited to finally see you get your hands on the game!

If you enjoyed your experience, be sure to leave a positive review on Steam as every single one of them helps Steam recommend it to more people! We’ll send a reminder later in the week for this.

Enjoy your time bringing forth chaos and evil in the world of Worship!

Sincerely, 
- The Chasing Rats Team

notes.title: Dev Diaries #8 - Hubryus Descends into Worship for Early Access
notes.content:
[p]Early Access is right around the corner and we hope you are as excited as we are for Worship’s unveiling. This update will all revolve around Hubryus, the first unlockable god in the game. [/p][p][/p][p]Before jumping into it, we have a surprise to share with you; [/p][p]As we're unraveling more details about the Sower of Insanity, we've [url="https://distrokid.com/hyperfollow/landremonette/worship-the-sower-of-insanity-original-soundtrack-2"]released a micro-album[/url] of music tied to Hubryus. We suggest you listen to these eldritch hymns while diving into this update.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/ba6661bbb769ad494d28d8395fa6523ffa7aa7d0.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Under the starry night sky, a dark figure walked with purpose. Entering the clearing and leaving behind the dark tangle of trees and branches, the grizzled man looked up to the sky. His trembling momentarily stopped. Not out of sudden calmness, but frozen of overwhelming dread. Why wouldn’t anyone else see the truth? How were these fools able to go on about their lives, tending to their crops, all of it under the gaze of these horrors. As his stare shifted between the glowing celestial bodies, all he could see was monstrosities, biding their times until they would deign to devour the puny world he was standing on.[/i][/p][p][i]As his body continued shaking uncontrollably, the man finally knew he was at the right place, at the right time. The heavy burden he carried all this way on his shoulder let out of a muffled thud as it landed on the lush ground of the clearing.  *“Who’s the fool now?*” shrieked the lone madman toward the bloody corpse of his neighbor. He was doomed; they were all doomed. But he and only he was able to see the truth. Maybe if he dedicated all of himself to the cosmic gods, they would spare him. Perhaps they would even let him join them if he serves well enough. One day he could be the one staring at puny mortals, worlds apart, unaware of their impeding demise.[/i][/p][p][i]The madman’s purpose was clearer than ever, his resolve blindly hardened. His last remnant of sanity frayed in offering to the lunar eclipse. At last, he began to recite the words whispered in his mind as he donned his hood and unsheathed his knife. Hubryus marveled at the birth of a new apostle as it continued to murmur a welcome gift to his ear.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/eb8ab7fe247fee917241cf1d4a4d34f3fb509d63.png"][/img]Hubryus is a harbinger of transformation, an aspect of change. It warps beings, shapes them and creates a new purpose for them. Its mastery over metamorphosis is being reflected by its physical appearance: an ever-changing mass of tentacles with a plethora of eyes gazing through you. Through its experience with mortal and sentient beings, it found that the mind was the most potent for alteration. What it perceives as the pinnacle of transformation, humans see as madness.[/p][p]Let yourself go.[/p][p][b]Embrace insanity.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/e2ab033c9f05130066eb447d087335e1120ecd72.png"][/img][/p][p]Cults devoted to Hubryus are but tools used to twist and shape the world through all its aspects.[/p][p]While An-Ansgaidh is all about offense and carving your way in combat through raw combat prowess, Hubryus’ strengths are a bit more subdued. It will bestow you with ample powers to bring the horrors to the overworld. [/p][p]
[/p][h3]Embrace Madness[/h3][p]Cults centered around Hubryus devote themselves to the art of rituals. But instead of using rituals to tear the flesh of enemies, their magic is more around sculpting and creating new beings into this world. Some call them horrors, but you simply call it clay. Clay that you shape with your own bloody hands.[/p][p]While worshipping Hubryus adds more twisted beings into the world, you will also be able to create some of your own. The starting utility building you have will allow you to shape your own little beings into something uncharacterizable and prone to disturb the sane ones.[/p][h3]Summons[/h3][p]While not specifically tied to Hubryus, summoning rituals are making their way into Early Access for this first pass of content. Categorized under “Sealed Rituals,” these summons require a bit more time and skill to draw their associated shape, but your time and efforts will be rewarded plentifully. Summons come in all shapes and forms and will aid you in the most difficult of combats.[/p][p]As a devout follower of Hubryus, you will start with one summoning ritual: The Goopling.[/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/d09d009ec7940e5a1564e0ea6063c5ffe2a70c53.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/454b6331a9a42746a7155eb91ace62818cdcf05b.png"][/img][/p][p]That is all for today! Hubryus is the first unlockable god of Worship. We hope this overview gives you a good idea on what's to come throughout the Early Access development of the game. We're looking forward to seeing what you'll do with the [i]glass canonny[/i] nature of Hubryus' starting kit when the game launches next week! [/p][p][/p][p]Until then, be wary when glancing at the Eclipse; it might stare back. [/p]

notes.title: Dev Diaries #6 - What's it like to Worship An-Ansgaidh?
notes.content:
Gods are an important part of Worship’s lore and world, but they also play an even more important role in your identity as a cult leader. Today, we’ll be taking a closer look at An-Ansgaidh, the first worshippable Elder God in our demo. What could be hiding behind its featureless face? This update is covering it all. 
Get ready ‘cause we’re jumping right into it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/0332effc6f249da5732cfea60f78bc9242ba9c28.png[/img]

Boasting an almost immaterial appearance with its silky white skin, its humanoid shape is a ghastly sight. Its two elongated arms end with abnormally large claws, soaked in blood up to its forearms. A head empty of features is only adorned with a crudely painted eye. The flesh of its skinny belly is torn up, arms reaching out of it, grasping for something.

An-Ansgaidh is the bane of every living thing. Being the most compassionate among the Old Gods, it could not bear witness to the hardships and sufferings of mortal beings over the length of their fragile existence. What once was empathy became twisted and mutated into hatred directed towards mortality. No longer would it stand idle while mortals struggled for survival until time deigns bring an end to their fruitless lifetime. It will be there instead, rending their flesh, mercifully freeing these poor souls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/228269ef53741276a0504b1eaf37428e2494939a.png[/img]

Cults devoted to the Herald of Annihilation have adopted its twisted vision. Its followers have their sights on the extinction of sentient life, and as such, they are fearsome warriors. Acts of faith for An-Ansgaidh are of the murdery kind.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/ba4a09a6bae8accf228e49d0ea8e41d29b30751e.gif[/img]

As a cult worshipping An-Ansgaidh, your main goal is to liberate all those poor souls. Your starting arsenal should reflect that. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/baac2a528f74bb2a9e25bad3ceaba40215801b21.gif[/img]

[h3]Berserk Followers[/h3]
Unlocked by default, this perk allows your followers to attack faster the more damage they receive during a fight. Followers of An-Ansgaidh are true zealots and should not fear pain. They are instead emboldened by it.

[h3]Ghastly Claws[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/58cea5c6853956162259e198faeef8c20f4e45fb.png[/img]

Call upon An-Ansgaidh’s will in the shape of spectral claws to rend the flesh of your enemies. These may look spectral in nature, but they will tear apart anything that comes in contact with them.
Ghastly Claws is a ritual available by default once you select An-Ansgaidh as your God. 

[h3]The Sculptor[/h3]
A fervent admirer of The Herald of Annihilation, this one little fella’ established himself in your base as a way to pursue his passion for making effigies in honor of An-Ansdaidh.
This sculptor serves as your cult’s utility building. Trade him your extra catalysts to have him sculpt the most perfect of An-Ansgaidh statues.
These precious works of art can then be offered to the altar for some extra devotion points and freshly summoned followers for your cult!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/ec79ac4129e3f40f31461f27da699fe9567a748e.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/454b6331a9a42746a7155eb91ace62818cdcf05b.png[/img]
That's it for today! We hope that it enlightened you a bit more about An-Ansgaidh's motives and how it reflects on you as a carrier of its faith. Will you fully embrace An-Ansgaidh and worship it or will you choose another Elder God? Let us know!

Until then, see you next time for another Diary entry!

notes.title: Dev. Diaries #5 - New Features coming for Next Fest
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Cultists! [/h1]

As you know, Steam’s Next Fest is coming today and with it some important additions in terms of quality of life for the Demo. To celebrate this, we've revamped our trailer a bit to show the upcoming features that will be coming today.

[previewyoutube=D3ba8hfZl-0;full][/previewyoutube]

Steam Next Fest is an important event for Indies and one of the last remaining key promotion beat we have for Worship before its early access release. Your participation in the Next Fest in the first few days has a huge impact on the visibility of Worship throughout the event. So if you'd like to give us a bit of support, the best way is to play the updated version of the Worship Demo on Steam at 12:00 EST!

Today’s Dev. Update will serve as a little [i]mise en bouche[/i] for the upcoming features for the Demo! Let’s go through them in rapid fire. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/c6172c2d43d6611e86ba6c8b201b55bdfa8367f4.png[/img]

As a direct response to the community's feedback, we are implementing two new ways to help you manage your build/upgrades. This has been grazed a bit during previous updates, so we'll be quick about it!

[h2]A new face joins your cult[/h2]

Seen as a little An-An Afficionado, this new NPC will be there to stay as long as you revere An-Ansgaidh!

Always looking for inspiration, he will chip away at your extra catalysts in no time, turning them into magnificent works of art! Even An-Ansgaidh will be incredibly pleased to see these objects at its altar.

Play the new version of the Demo to find out! 

[h2]Breaking your own upgrades[/h2]

We're adding a way to destroy your own buildings. That's right, you'll be able to tweak your build a bit by destroying the building holding the corresponding upgrade. Mistakes happen or luck may not be on your side at the start, but rest assured that you'll be able to replace the upgrades you do not need anymore to make way for ones you'd like.

We purposefully set the time to destroy your own buildings to be a tad bit longer, just in case you change your mind or you sent the command by accident!

Keep in mind that once destroyed, the buildings do not turn back into catalysts. So you'll have to be extra, extra sure before destroying them!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/37e1c55f98a65ebded47f1c4cbefea7b266d9957.png[/img]
[h3]Soul VFX[/h3]
We implemented some new VFXs to help with the overall clarity regarding followers. When sending out your mob against enemies and your followers get knocked by one of their stronger attacks, it can get confusing pretty quickly as to who died and who survived.

Luckily, we added one VFX to help you see which ones died! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/bbc277db8c4903faacb2abd7eacea48f0e54c104.gif[/img]

[h3]Stunned Status Effect[/h3]
When enemies or followers are incapacitated, they will display some swirling stars around their head. This added VFX helps to add clarity to the game in many ways. One is that in addition to the souls leaving their bodies, you will know exactly which followers are still up and alive to keep on fighting. The other is to display as a status effect on enemies when their shields are broken. When these go on, it’s your sign to unleash your mob on them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/6a9bf808cf278a8809a361848e1fe07707106f22.gif[/img]


[h3]Your cultist is hidden by assets? We got you (un)covered![/h3]

This addition has been in the works for a little while now but we’re finally adding it to a playable build! This shader allows you to see behind assets when your cultist walks behind them. Pretty handy when you come across an object that's hidden behind some trees or walls!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/bf93177fab20e345d9be53a107aea2a4d2d1f526.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/f8727b23be15d0443a71fcc87afd6f068a0efd67.png[/img]

In the demo, you will also notice a newly made UI when you start a game session; the God Selection Screen.

As a cultist, you will have the honor to choose the Eldritch God of your choice and we made sure to have an interface well suited for the occasion. Chose wisely, because the God you chose will impact which load out you will have for your run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/5fa2a29290437412faf6324b86755a38d2a005d5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/454b6331a9a42746a7155eb91ace62818cdcf05b.png[/img]
That's it for this update! We hope you're ready and excited for today and all of the features that's coming your way. As we said above, the Next Fest is super important for indie devs as it helps us push the game towards more people. Any participation counts so go tell your friends!

See you next time for the next Diary entry!
- The Chasing Rats Team

notes.title: Dev. Diaries #4 - Narrative Spotlight: Untamed Borderlands
notes.content:
Greetings Cultists!
After a little Holiday break, we are back again and ready to talk more about Worship and what makes our game unique. This month will be taking a narrative turn as we will be doing a narrative highlight on the zone you’re currently playing on in the Demo: The Untamed Borderlands!

But first, it’s important for you to have a little more context about the two factions that are currently at war in this zone. Let’s jump straight into it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/04798cec657ae42beca573e4e2bb106edab6719b.png[/img]

[h3]The Last Church[/h3]
Established as the belief of the common folk for more than five centuries now, the Last Church is supported all around the world. Its constituents pray to the Shattered Goddess, a motherly and compassionate holy being whose power can bring about miracles for the people of the land. But only a select few know of the terrible secrets that the Church has been holding for so long. Dark and eldritch secrets that have been present ever since the Church’s inception.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/d02591889314038de7cab2133572250d7e7133ec.png[/img]

Salithys the Deceit Weaver bears her name proudly, she has managed to dupe most of humanity into believing in a just and pure Goddess, an idol fabricated by lies. Assuming the identity of the Shattered Goddess, the Elder God has an army at her command that is ready to purify the land and its people in her name. In addition to worshippers of the Goddess, Salithys has at her command a small force of corrupt leaders who are aware of the truth. With help from within the mortal realm, she can quietly single out and erase any who tries to expose her secrets to the masses.

[h3]The Akkas[/h3]
In the world of Worship, the term Untamed is used by the so called civilized to describe those living outside conventional society. This appellation is applied to both sentient beings and mysterious creatures still roaming uncharted territory. Among the ones referred to as Untamed, the Akka tribes are the most noteworthy. Despite their primitive way of life, this ancestral race has managed to hold its territory and unique culture in a world dominated by humans. Their way of life has made them close to nature and dedicated to seeking both mastery in their vocation and balance in the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/14cfe8573b2f1c468eb7032e7329b780f2104373.png[/img]
Akkas carve important part of their history into huge stones

The initially tense relations they had with The Church wanting to forcefully convert them and the Coven desiring to study them escalated into all out hostility. The Akkas defend their sacred territories fiercely, as their culture and livelihood depends on it. Both hunters and shamans from Akka tribes are capable of fighting to protect their home. The otherworldly horrors that are recently making their appearance in the mortal realm are their sworn enemies. To the Akkas, they are a disgrace to nature itself and must be eliminated at all costs to maintain balance between all living things.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/f525f2e3f4aa28f6e365386f7542bf71b339af16.png[/img]

Under the guise of reclaiming what was the Shattered Goddess’, the Last Church’s purpose is clear: find the angels scattered throughout the world and bring them back to the Shattered Goddess to make her family whole again. The Inquisition is ruthless in their approach, they will stop at nothing to find the angels. They have been informed that no cost is too great if it means acquiring more power in the name of the Goddess and so they marched with resolve towards the Untamed Borderlands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/36bcda6aa17c6f83d6d64f73cca03c60ed0d137e.png[/img]

One thing is for certain, if the Inquisition is headed your way, you should pray to the Shattered Goddess for mercy.

Regardless of the Last Church propaganda, the Untamed Borderlands is to this day very much contested by the Akka tribes of the region. The forces of the Inquisition are greater in numbers, which gave them the edge in the territorial takeover. That being said, they are struggling to keep it under control, suffering heavy losses to Untamed ambushes and guerrilla warfare. Chapels and other religious sites dedicated to the Shattered Goddess are vengefully vandalized by Akka warriors. A reminder that this land is theirs. This feud will be paid back in blood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/2921563e17bd468dd3d40524f5996a8a4beedd9f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/38eef9de6b4225db80b39430eb74e7fd7753ccba.png[/img]

Walking around and establishing your cult knowing these conditions, you will be bound to find remnants of past conflicts. And some might still be ongoing. Though rare, it is possible to find these two factions fighting while exploring these uncharted lands. One clever cultist might also use this to its own advantage. Forcing encounters on these two warring factions is also a viable strategy when it comes to fighting them. 

Despite the inhospitality of the region, a growing cult could definitely make some worthy finds. From worn battlefields to traces of the Church’s many attempts at creating a settlement, you will be able to find many landmarks that reflect this narrative setup. Your ritual book will be sure to comment on anything it finds interesting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/257b6d16a3d367f0fccca7c20836d3602ec55bd2.gif[/img]

Lore entries are interactable objects that are scattered around the world. Taking the shape of a floating ghastly book, interacting with it will give you more context on the location you’re on and even give you some eldritch insight into what truly happened at some specific locations.
Be on the lookout for these interactables when exploring the game world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/454b6331a9a42746a7155eb91ace62818cdcf05b.png[/img]

That’s it for today! We hope this Dev Diary entry helps you to have some insight regarding the narrative choices we made for this map specifically. If you enjoyed it, let us know in the comments!
Next update we’ll be talking about the upcoming Steam Next Fest and the features we plan to update for the Demo. Stay tuned for next entry!

notes.title: Dev. Diaries #3 - Blood & Rituals
notes.content:
Welcome back cultists! It’s been a bit more than a month since we last talked about Worship and all the little details that make our game unique regarding combat. This month, our Dev Diary is going to get bloody as we will be tackling everything that has to do with rituals and drawing with your own blood! Are you ready? Let’s jump into it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/79d54ee83abb7d56284f00c80dfdcd0b47f38ab9.png[/img]

As an aspiring cultist on their way to bring the end of the world, you will have many means at your disposal to reach your ultimate goal. Being grim and evil is not just about appearances, you know? Let’s talk about the real deal: the dark arts and the magic behind it! Rituals will be an essential part of your arsenal as a cultist, after all.
Rituals are Worship's take on casting spells and it also enables various ways to interact with the world with its many puzzles. Rituals are designed with cooperative play in mind, because nothing is more fun than painting with your friend's blood!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/c2d4677d6bcb6012877f3a42310b8aa25c2ce417.png[/img]

Blood is an important resource in the world of Worship. You will have to manage it carefully as it is both your life force and your ink bottle. Pay close attention to how much you’ll spill or you’ll leave yourself vulnerable for the next incoming attack! Fortunately for you, your followers are more than eager to share their own life force to aid in your grim endeavors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/02026e6a12280f0ec8f3704cd5e23d687d6b57af.gif[/img]

Risk does come with better rewards. As you spill more blood and take more time to draw these bloody shapes on the ground, your magic will become more powerful. Casting a bigger ritual will allow it to have stronger effects. It also works the other way around too! Smaller shapes will result in a weaker ritual or less charges for your spells.

For bigger spells that have charges, a useful tip would be to draw the shapes in advance. That way, you’ll be prepared when danger arises!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/5b4d3e167e0d1b1b356dd295d75b4264abedf467.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/9afb9c1200fa0a6468a2354ff8336766c916d4a3.png[/img]

The game will be sure to tell you which kind of shape it recognizes while you draw. This helps you to know when your ritual is good enough to activate.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/54e69bdee07a9922c7a90a476a5dfcb250744a6a.gif[/img]
If you don’t see this little bubble pop up above your head after drawing a ritual, you’ll have to re-do it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/fd70f9c6a254955b3895c5e76e18a88191b63f89.png[/img]

Combat is where all the action will take place. Maybe you'll have prepared your rituals beforehand or maybe you'll paint them right as the action happens. If that’s the case, your loyal mob will be here to distract your enemies while you work towards tipping the scale.
You'll have a few rituals in your cultist arsenal to get rid of your opponents. No matter which one you have at hand, you will always stand a chance. As long as you can keep the blood flowing, the eldritch powers will provide you plenty of means to retaliate against your enemies. Always keep an eye on your health bar though!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/f57ea3aded6ad46235809a73ac5303375f122cb5.gif[/img]

Offensive rituals are split into two categories: instant cast and active effects rituals.
Instant rituals, such as Impale, is a ritual that has its effect go out immediately when you activate it. Active effects rituals will give you charges of a spell to use whenever you see fit. Both of these rituals can be ‘active’ at the same time. Meaning you won’t have to use all of your spell charges before activating an instant effect ritual.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/0c4d7d04e82555417fe3c891f0a73ae2f22c97e7.png[/img]
Some puzzles and encounters will require you to spill that sweet, sweet, crimson juice in order to complete them. What kind of secrets will your precious blood uncover? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/8bf521edcb615927817e2e5013372db48255702d.png[/img]

The Painter module is one of the bigger types of content that features the blood drawing mechanic in one of its completion paths.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/a1d707237c119496278650d5381e6234c2c0bd2e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/b165706bdcdb1a1f08ca7ea940cdda25df65445a.png[/img]
[h3]Sealed Rituals[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/dac10385871d7f0cfbeff0d4bf07343ebeb643be.png[/img]

It is said that some rituals are so powerful that they require some great feats in order to be uncovered. Sealed Rituals are a bit stronger than your usual spells and are correspondingly tougher to unlock. Amongst them lies the Tribute ritual, which allows you to offer the bodies of slain enemies to your God.

Sealed Rituals are usually more complex to draw and require a bit more time and execution than their normal counterparts. In exchange for your trouble, their activation will reward you with powerful effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/8fd0922756c9c506f63e62d0603b91e288bf3609.gif[/img]
Offer slain enemies to your god using the Tribute ritual. Obtain rewards in exchange for their bodies. And if you don’t have anything to offer to your god, you can still Tribute your own followers… eh eh eh. 

[h3]Angel Blood[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/5cf7c99ff09b32a205fc7857d5a89debd2c610aa.png[/img]

Through the blood of her so-called angels, the Deceit Weaver is able to bestow her devotees clad in white and gold with a glimpse of her powers. Within the blood of all four angels lies a fraction of Salithys’ abilities according to the aspect they represent: healing, control, power and illusion. In an act they consider sacred, bishops periodically collect blood from Valhyni and Nobilia. The amassed blood is then used in one of two ways to draw its eldritch properties.

The blood can be refined into incense through a rigorous process known by few church officials. Inhaling mist produced by one of these “sacred” incense grants inhuman powers. This is how some bishops and church leaders can magically heal wounds and convert enemies into docile servants.  
However, the Church is aware of another dreadful property of angel’ blood. Drinking it triggers violent mutation on humans, turning them into brainless hulks of warped flesh. A terrifying hint pointing towards the true nature of these winged horrors. Following the guidance of their Goddess and its loyal eyes of the sanctum, the inquisition had no qualm in using this angelic blood property in inhuman experimentation on church enemies and servants alike. Executioners and other drudge created in this manner bolster the ranks of the Inquisition while some even more unsightly results of these experiments remain hidden as trump cards for decisive battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/80944b676d36e96de024fa318ed3f65ed1f5fb71.png[/img]

Ulmira paid a high price for a small vial of angel blood in order to save her daughter Eleanor. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/454b6331a9a42746a7155eb91ace62818cdcf05b.png[/img]
That’s all you need to know about blood and rituals for now! Do you have a favorite ritual so far? What kind of drawing will you do once you get your hands on Worship? Do let us know in the comments section!
See you next time!
-The Chasing Rats Team

notes.title: Dev. Diaries #2 - Combat
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/dad4b29227709336d4a2f24290d310578f44bf76.png[/img]
In today’s Dev Diary, we are looking into the combat system in Worship. Since Worship’s gameplay includes a lot of novelty in its mechanics, a little of context is needed to properly understand combat in the game. 

Quick overview on Worship terminology: when we talk about a [i]Cultist[/i], it defines the playable character. When we talk about [i]Followers[/i], we talk about the cute little mascot looking fellas following the Cultist. As a Cultist, you can bleed yourself to draw symbols on the ground to cast rituals. The most important ritual to a cultist arsenal is the conversion rituals, which will convert followers to your cult. As a Cultist, you can order your Followers to do different tasks, including fist fighting enemies. 

While in combat, you will have access to three types of actions to defeat your enemies: [i]Followers, Rituals and Follower Throw[/i]. Each of those actions have a different purpose in combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/39c3755c9e3ec14ae910f2cb1727c4618e096f37.png[/img]

Followers are a multipurpose resource in Worship. During exploration, they will carry stuff, help you solve puzzle and interact with the world. They can even be used as a blood source to heal your Cultist. 

During combat, their main purpose is to grab the enemies’ attention and buy you time. Even with their small size, followers are now surprisingly tanky. Send them to attack your enemies to take some hits for you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/9063cecba4f2a83f00e29b0ed92743003467bbd1.gif[/img]

After a few hits, followers will be knocked down and vulnerable. Once they’re down, they are not quite dead yet, but they are most likely to die in a hit or two. If they survive, they will eventually get back up and automatically regenerate their missing health. They will also regenerate their hidden health bar out of combat. That, way, they’ll be fresh and ready to take more hits for your next bloodshed! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/6b4e1a3f9abc2c8a24a54537a4ea4ed7aafbb728.gif[/img]

To prevent losing followers, you can still recall your followers to dodge powerful attacks while they are standing. Be wary, if they get knocked down, you will not be able to recall them back until they get back up by themselves. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/4d36cb244bff25079ad175eb63c1866ec24296c0.gif[/img]

Followers are able to damage enemies when they’re fighting, but it is not the most effective way to defeat enemies. Unless you have an overwhelmingly amount of them, obviously. 

Although followers are used to grab enemies’s attention during combat, this does not mean that the Cultist will never be in danger. Enemies have attacks in their move sets specifically aimed for the Cultist. Be wary of the Inquisitor quick dash, it will catch you off-guard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/fe1a41de9303e71753725ed3c5ad9843ca581406.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/99085ff4f2a934c614456bfc0d679b785c35888c.png[/img]
It can be counter intuitive, especially for new players, to use your own resources (either your health or the life of a follower) to draw blood symbols while you have a bunch of enemies trying to kill you. But even then, rituals are the most powerful actions a player can use to defeat enemies. You cannot make an omelet without breaking a few eggs, as the saying goes…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/04dc5d974504c81bf6414bcb40225326fd514f12.gif[/img]

Your Followers will buy you time, enough for you to draw these bloody shapes on the ground and activating them. Rituals are the key for you to win fights quickly while preventing too many casualties on your side. 

There are two types of offensive rituals: instant cast and active effects rituals. 

Instant rituals, such as Impale, is a ritual who’s going to have its effect go out immediately once you activate it.

Active effects rituals will give you charges of a spell to use whenever you see fit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/d2cf5fe08770602617da9e7df4c915d0fa2f4fe8.gif[/img]

In terms of size, obviously, the bigger the drawing is, the bigger the amount of blood spent. Players will be rewarded by having certain aspects of the rituals scaling depending on the size of a shape. Obviously, for any area of effects, it’s easy to imagine why you would draw a bigger shape. For active effects rituals, we can scale it in different ways. For exemple, for the Ghastly Claw ritual, a bigger size will give a higher number of charges. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/eed07b3fcc32d676787625d1498922831fadb37e.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/0b7cd9298c96b18ce81f85cfcd3a7bc5bf91a385.png[/img]

Finally, these adorable followers are multipurpose. They’re also throwable! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/02cf86cc2fd1d0873e6698fd1665616980ae1b89.gif[/img]

Other than being really funny, throwing a follower will slightly damage the enemies, but it can also interrupt some attacks. Some abilities will grey out the health bar of the enemies and display a variable number of shields over it while they charge up the attack. During that time, enemies don’t take any damage but, by throwing followers to the enemies while they’re charging, you can destroy their shields. If you manage to destroy all the shields before the attack releases, you’ll cancel it and slightly stun your target.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/b0cfb6e997b3e4e91f77dd37972b63a0bc0b3713.gif[/img]

Some rituals will also be effective to destroy shields. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/13e1babf8592aa9011f131ba621539cb69a0af72.png[/img]

Cultist has a way to directly damage  enemies without the use of followers or rituals. With a simple input, you can cast a small damaging spell to attack your enemies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/d8fdb5140bd747ef2690b35865431d726b8e437c.gif[/img]

You will have to be careful with this attack, since every eldritch power has a price. Using this attack will cost you blood. It is meant to be an emergency tool if combat goes dire. 

Each god will have a different basic attacks for its cultists to add more variety in your play sessions depending on which deity you choose to worship.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/3c9a96a041fb172dbbb0ad6609268abfdf7f993c.png[/img]
To summarize, the “rules” of design we establish are the following: use followers to crowd control, use rituals to damage enemies and throw your followers to interrupt attacks. 

But as we all know, rules are meant to be broken, and that’s where the upgrades take place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/d341c45033d84ad0af31ad4f3b699e9b95f8602c.gif[/img]

During your run, you will stumble upon worm-filled crystals called Catalysts. They can be used to spawn buildings granting you upgrades for your cult. By unlocking new powers, you will eventually unlock abilities which will let you break those rules. A pretty straight forward example would be an upgrade to your follower damage, but it can take various forms too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/4717d9f4df7a95a45d295cb3ae26411d844d2832.gif[/img]

An upgrade we currently have is the Follower Piercing upgrade, which let followers pass through enemies when you throw them, making it a lot more efficient to damage multiple enemies during combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/eb5119b0e1716664990dda2a10bdb81a0676e463.gif[/img]

We are eager to see what kind of builds and upgrades combinations players will create to surprise us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/454b6331a9a42746a7155eb91ace62818cdcf05b.png[/img]

That’s it for today! This should cover a bit of everything regarding combat. Hoping this update makes you even more excited to try out different strategies and offensive rituals while playing Worship!

Next Diary entry will be all about highlighting our game’s unique mechanic: blood drawings.

See you next time!

- The Chasing Rats Team

notes.title: Dev. Diaries #1 - Gameplay loop
notes.content:
Greetings Cultists!
We're here. Still active and working on Worship! You've probably seen some activity in our other socials as well as on our Kickstarter page which we update monthly. We do want to give Steam more attention starting now as we feel it's the next logical step for talking about our game.
We will be starting a new series on Steam where we'll be showcasing what we've been working on while highlighting certain elements of the game as well as its universe. We'll have a broader approach for today's update, presenting the concept of Worship's loop. Our next updates will cover some more detailed aspects of the game, so stay tuned for more!

In the meantime, hop along and let's dive straight into it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/d3f3cd7a80d14b89098be42d66152cdeed08d99f.png[/img]

If you clicked here, it means you're probably wondering about Worship, the game we have been working on. We feel that while our Steam page did the trick in explaining the broad concept of the game, it doesn't truly explain in details what we are going for!
So what is Worship about? Well, you are a cult leader worshipping one of the multiple elder gods in the world. Your ultimate goal is to provoke the end of world the way your chosen god envisioned it. Each god has its own goals and powers. Picking your god will greatly affect the arsenal of rituals at your disposal and consequently your approach during gameplay.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CBarINP.gif[/img]


[b][h3]TL;DR[/h3][/b]

• Explore the world around you, accomplishing various tasks and gathering rewards in the name of your eldritch deity, gathering both power and devotion. Devotion measures your overall progression with your faith and the god you worship.
• Once you’ve accumulated enough devotion, which is earned by doing most in-game objectives, return to its altar with all of your newfound abilities and allies. 
• You’ll then be tested in a challenging scenario, be it a battle, a riddle or some more unique circumstances. 
• Repeat the process with an ever evolving world that scales after each test, until you ultimately free your unholy god.
• Die (and retry). Death is part of the process as a cultist and you might not be able to accomplish your ultimate goal every run. Start over in a newly generated map with different things for you to encounter.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/d4ffe6da001ffe824c9a330cda50c81e14681599.png[/img]

Worship is a a roguelike game that focuses mainly on exploration and puzzles. You convert the godless into dispensable followers that you order around to do… pretty much all your dirty work. They fight for you, carry your precious loot around, and can be sacrificed to perform important rituals. They might look frail and easily replaceable, but they do pack a punch when their numbers increase.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/3c7f39d7a5827562a9f946e0fd36c834a68fbee3.gif[/img]
[i]The Godless appear white and can be converted to followers with the conversion ritual[/i]

Exploration is the main part of the game. As you delve into the world of Worship, you might encounter intricate puzzles to solve while on your way to expand your cult. You might also bump against different factions who are very keen on stopping you in your tracks. By ordering your followers around, you will be able to solve puzzles, fight enemies and carry all your precious loot in an efficient manner. Be careful not to loose to many in your cultish endeavours!

Combat in this game is a bit different compared to other games. A single cult-leader is powerless alone but with your ability to plan and coordinate your followers efficiently, you will stand a chance. Your followers will distract your enemies, leaving a window for you to create powerful rituals to hinder, injure or kill your enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/dbd56b2833b9aa22aa229d3a56c309757b367d37.gif[/img]
[i]The Impale ritual stuns the Shcrub squad, allowing your followers to swarm the remaining one quickly.[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/17f7be2f25637a77f769a1b049b81c878f88b129.png[/img]

Devotion is an important mechanic in the world of Worship. It measures your overall progression with your god before it will test your faith once your bar is full. The amount of devotion gained will vary depending on your actions.

Sometimes, enemies and destructible objects might drop a relic. This intricate artifact will please your god greatly if you can bring it back to the altar and offer it to your god.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/26faa0581e4df8227c07be343dd76f8c05fb23f6.gif[/img]
[i]Relics are a good way to obtain a lot of devotion[/i]

Regardless, once your devotion bar is full, your test of faith will be ready.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/bb4e33241a56d8cfc106666ed0c8f63e120ca1e3.gif[/img]
[i]The screen will go dark and the world around you will change once you reach the maximum devotion.[/i]

Upon returning from your test, you will be asked to once again prove your worth to your god by accumulating devotion and facing more complex tests and hurdles. This will all culminate in one last test of faith which, once completed, will provide your deity with enough power to make their way into the mortal realm, finally granting you and the world a much deserved permanent rest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/212c981af799d7be8848c3e1c7891cb0992fe0f2.png[/img]

Every cult deserves its base! In Worship, buildings represent the various upgrades you will obtain during your run. As a reward for your deeds, some encounters will drop catalysts. Some objects might even drop these shiny crystals after being destroyed. Bringing them back to your cult base will transform them into upgrade buildings, giving you more power, better stats and even give you access to new rituals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/3b2f94cc737eaba981937b97e2aeb359a6789f1b.jpg[/img]
[i]Each catalyst has a distinct category tied to it. From left to right: Followers, Cultist, Rituals[/i]

You will be able to find 3 types of catalysts in the game: Rituals, Followers and Cultist, each one upgrading the corresponding category once activated inside of your cult base. On top of that, each catalyst has a tier which brings stronger and rarer effects depending on which one you end up looting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/6513054d067e57ecd781a557553461dc85acb41e.png[/img]

Once you reach the devotion limit, your god’s test of faith will be ready. You can keep exploring if you choose, accumulating more followers and upgrades on the way. Once you are ready, you can head back at the altar and pray to your god. This will teleport you and all of your followers to the test’s location. Make sure you have prepared accordingly as some tests will be combat oriented, while some might be intricate puzzles to solve.

The test of faith is an evaluation of your talents as a devoted cultist to your elder god, a moment to truly prove your worth to the being you’ve dedicated your very soul to. In other words, it’s a boss encounter. Tests of faith are meant to punctuate gameplay with unique powerful moments that challenge your talents and gatekeep the next part of your playthrough.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/158aef78f886ba17bf76bf70534b5ffc1761799e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/c5524d51cb7b99b2de4aab9c2a2acb17f5e765fb.png[/img]

Dying and retrying is part of Worship as a whole. While the world of Worship has its load of dangers and enemies, some Tests of Faith will measure your ability to perform rituals and fight under pressure. Not all runs will end up being successful and dying is an important part of the process for your journey to end the world. You will still be able to find comfort in death as in between runs, and depending on what you accomplish during them, you might unlock different kinds of encounters, rituals and even new gods to worship. The world will once again be yours to explore, but will change in between your attempts. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/9aec1a2e886c110c94634118ff91f5026c7f501c.png[/img]

That was the first edition of our Dev Diaries! We hope it helped you grasp a little bit more of what the game will feel like.
Make sure you join our Discord server to be notified for further announcements regarding the game!

See you next time!
- Chasing Rats Games

notes.content:
The Asylum Direct is an indie game showcase, made by the Indie Asylum, a group of indie game developer sharing office space, best practices and expanses to become better developers as a group. 

Not only the Asylum Direct is this a way to show you all what we’ve been working on, it’s also a celebration of those who made them and indie games as a whole. The collective has put together exclusive interviews, brand new game announcements, fun and creative showcase, new gameplay footage and game keys to win by participating live. 

Obviously, Worship and Chasing Rats Games will be featured in the Direct. We hope to see you there!

The event will be live on YouTube and Twitch on Thursday the 31st of January at 12h15 PM EST.

[url=https://www.asylumdirect.com/]More information regarding the Asylum Direct here![/url]

notes.title: Save & Sound - A celebration of music in games!
notes.content:
[h2]Get ready![/h2]

Join us July 14 - 18 right here on Steam for one of the largest digital expos about audio and music in games. Featuring concerts, deep-dives, and mashups from 70+ developers from around the world, prepare your eyes & ears for a unique event!

Starting at 10am PDT / 7pm CEST, a 4-day live show from July 14 to 17 will stream showcasing all the wonderful content made just for Save & Sound. 

We are happy to be opening the Save & Sound Festival with a mega medley of our games, including Worship! Join us for an amazing performance by talented musicians on the 14th of July at 10 am PDT!

[h2]Don’t miss out on updates![/h2]

Set a reminder to be notified when Save & Sound will go live!

The show will be streamed on the Save & Sound website. Check out all the games part of the event on [url=saveandsound.io]saveandsound.io[/url]

notes.title: New gameplay teaser!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/e2507c6ef7344d797d43f08d68fecd3262d49679.gif[/img]

Hi everyone! While the game is still very much in development, we recently released a gameplay teaser where you can see the game in action. It shows a glimpse of combat, but also some of the unique features of Worship such as drawing with blood to unleash the eldritch powers of an old god. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/28127279737b1caba33be7fb41c4391c0b2759ab.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=AZY5JtYo8Fg;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/c8456102b2e540cee885eb036956e737eeb62983.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/2bb250d73de857c3bdac7a2dfed8e5561881c363.png[/img]

The world of Worship is home to four distinct factions that will each react to your cult’s presence and actions during gameplay. One of these factions is the Last Church, it has been established as the belief of the common folk, devoted to a benevolent Goddess, a false idol fabricated by Salithys the eldritch god known as the Deceit Weaver.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/1ea765fcdfe345aef03a49ed7303c27cafafd127.png[/img]

We did a narrative spotlight on the Last Church[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chasingratsgames/worship/posts/3431528] in our latest Kickstarter Update[/url] and went over some of the elements that will give the faction a solid, unique identity. These narrative elements will surface in Worship's gameplay through encounters with the church, enemies, environments and more! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/349b5b76580940e7f4993ec072bda70624089baa.png[/img]

We’ve also featured a new song from Worship’s soundtrack. A Goddess Veiled in Lies is meant to offer a proper insight into Salithys and her influence on the Last Church. This is one of our favourites so far and we hope you’ll listen to it on repeat for days just like we did.

[previewyoutube=rFCrmFcT-8Q;full][/previewyoutube] 

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chasingratsgames/worship/posts/3431528][b]If you want to learn more about the Last Church and see some dope artwork, you should click here to read our latest development update.[/b][/url]

That's all for the moment, the team is still hard at work on Worship and we can't wait to show you more gameplay as we progress steadily towards an awesome game!
